reason: Both correctly reassure the homeowner that pan-dependent buzzing is normal and neither recommends parts or a service call, matching the hidden truth. Conversation 2 is clearly better because it identifies the real cause ('multi-layer sandwich bases can buzz or crackle'), pre-empts the fan run-on as normal, gives practical mitigation (lower power, try a different pot, check base flatness) that effectively covers the sensible first-step checks, and gives a precise, relevant worry list (codes, noise with every pan, cracked glass). Conversation 1 is correct but thin, slightly mis-attributes the noise to 'heavy, thick-bottomed' pans (the quiet cast iron contradicts that), and its tripping/scorch safety panel is boilerplate not tied to the situation.
